caption:
A simple split for your paycheck. 🧮

Try 50/30/20: about 50% for needs, 30% for wants, 20% for savings and debt.

If your rent eats more than 50%, don't panic. Adjust the numbers to fit your life. The point is having a plan.

Which bucket is the hardest for you right now?
